The role involves building end\-to\- end ML pipelines, prototyping novel AI\-powered features, developing AI tools, and collaborating closely with engineering, product, and marketing partners to bring intelligent solutions into production. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in machine learning, statistical modeling, and AI framework development with strong problem\-solving and interpersonal skills, ensuring effective collaboration and measurable impact in a fast\-paced environment.

Strong product sense and a passion for user experience.  

  

Experience developing AI tools, frameworks, or APIs to support model deployment or LLM\-based applications.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field with 3\+ years of relevant experience; or MS with 5\+ years of experience in applied AI, machine learning, or statistical modeling.  

  

3\+ years of programming proficiency with Python for data science and AI (e.g., Pandas, Scikit\-learn, NumPy).  

  

3\+ years of hands\-on experience applying statistical modeling and machine learning algorithms for supervised and unsupervised learning (classification, regression, clustering, etc.).  

  

3\+ years of experience working with large\-scale data and distributed systems (e.g., Hadoop, Spark).  

  

Working familiarity with causal inference models and techniques.  

  

Hands\-on experience deploying AI/ML models into a production environment.  

  

Experience with LLM fine\-tuning, prompt engineering, or retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG).  

  

Experience with rapid prototyping, reproduction, and validation of research ideas.

jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------


We're seeking a talented Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join our growing engineering team at InfiniteChoice. You'll lead the design and development of cloud\-native software solutions that serve millions of users and power billions in transaction volume.


As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you'll own the complete software development lifecycle from solution design and implementation through testing, production deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement. AI\-driven development is a core part of how we build software. You'll leverage modern AI development tools and agentic workflows throughout the engineering lifecycle to accelerate development, improve quality, automate testing, troubleshoot issues and continuously improve production systems.


We're looking for engineers who combine strong software engineering fundamentals with an AI\-first mindset using AI as a force multiplier while maintaining ownership of architecture, code quality, security, reliability and business outcomes.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

### **AI\-Driven End\-to\-End Product Development**

* **Design**: Partner with Product and Design to translate business requirements into technical designs, leveraging AI to accelerate requirements analysis, solution exploration, technical specifications and implementation planning.
* **Development**: Build scalable full\-stack applications using Node.js, Vue.js/React, JavaScript/TypeScript and cloud\-native technologies while leveraging AI\-assisted development and agentic coding workflows to accelerate implementation.
* **Code Quality**: Leverage AI\-assisted code reviews and analysis to identify defects, security risks, architectural inconsistencies, code duplication and opportunities for greater component and service reusability.
* **Testing**: Use AI to develop and continuously improve comprehensive automated testing across unit, integration, end\-to\-end, regression, and performance testing.
* **Deployment**: Own applications through production deployment using automated CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices, leveraging AI\-driven automation where appropriate.
* **Monitoring \& Operations**: Own production health through observability, performance monitoring, alerting and incident response, using AI\-assisted analysis to accelerate troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and remediation.
* **Continuous Improvement**: Use production telemetry, customer behavior, incidents and engineering metrics to identify opportunities to continuously improve product quality, reliability, performance and maintainability.

### **Cloud\-Native Software Development**

* Architect and develop scalable services using Node.js and modern application frameworks.
* Build dynamic, responsive user experiences using Vue.js/React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Design APIs, services and integration patterns that enable reusable capabilities across applications.
* Build serverless and containerized applications for scalable cloud deployment.
* Design software for performance, security, resilience, observability and maintainability.
* Apply strong architectural principles and engineering judgment when evaluating and validating AI\-generated solutions.

### **Technical Excellence \& AI\-First Engineering**

* Champion AI\-driven software engineering practices across the complete development lifecycle.
* Continuously experiment with and adopt modern AI development tools, coding agents, and engineering automation that improve developer productivity and software quality.
* Treat AI\-generated code with the same engineering rigor as human\-written code, ensuring solutions meet architectural, security, performance, testing, and maintainability standards.
* Write clean, modular, reusable and maintainable code following established engineering standards.
* Identify opportunities to create reusable components, services, patterns, and automation rather than duplicating solutions across products.
* Participate in technical design and code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers.
* Contribute to architecture decisions and platform improvements.
* Share effective AI\-assisted engineering techniques and best practices across the team.

### **Collaboration \& Ownership**

* Take full ownership of features and services from concept and technical design through production deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization.
* Work closely with Product, Design, Platform, CloudOps and other engineering teams to deliver business outcomes.
* Proactively identify and remove technical blockers rather than waiting for direction.
* Communicate technical concepts, design decisions, risks, and trade\-offs effectively to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrate strong ownership and urgency in driving deliverables through the finish line.
* Build solutions and documentation that enable other engineers to understand, maintain, and extend your work.

**What You Must Have**
